verses.sloka: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां यज्ञवाटगतो नृपः ।ऋषीन्सर्वान्महातेजाः शब्दापयति राघवः ।। ७.९६.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāṁ rajanyāṁ vyuṣṭāyāṁ yajñavāṭagato nṛpaḥ ।ṛṣīnsarvānmahātejāḥ śabdāpayati rāghavaḥ ।। 7.96.1 ॥

translations.english: When that night had dawned, King Rama, the greatly effulgent one, having gone to the sacrificial enclosure, summoned all the sages.
translations.hindi: उत्तरकाण्ड का अठहत्तरवाँ सगं समाप्त हुआ । न्य एकोनाशीतितमः सर्ग; णणा:0--- तदद्‌ भुततमं वाक्यं श्र॒त्वागस्त्यस्य राघव! । गौरवाद्विस्मयाचेत्र भूयः पष्ठ प्रचक्रमे

verses.sloka: वसिष्ठो वामदेवश्च जाबालिरथ काश्यपः ।विश्वामित्रो दीर्घतपा दुर्वासाश्च महातपाः ।। ७.९६.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭho vāmadevaśca jābāliratha kāśyapaḥ ।viśvāmitro dīrghatapā durvāsāśca mahātapāḥ ।। 7.96.2 ॥

translations.english: Vasistha, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kashyapa, Vishwamitra of great austerity, and Durvasa of great penance were present.
translations.hindi: हे भगवन्‌ ! जिस बन में विद्भदेशाधिपति श्वेत तप करता था, बह्‌ घोर वन किस लिए पशुपक्षीहीन हुआ ?

verses.sloka: पुलस्त्यो ऽपि तथा शक्तिर्भार्गवश्चैव वामनः ।मार्कण्डेयश्च दीर्घायुर्मौद्गल्यश्च महायशाः ।। ७.९६.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: pulastyo 'pi tathā śaktirbhārgavaścaiva vāmanaḥ ।mārkaṇḍeyaśca dīrghāyurmaudgalyaśca mahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.96.3 ॥

translations.english: Pulastya, Shakti, Bhargava, Vamana, the long-lived Markandeya, and the highly renowned Maudgalya were also present.
translations.hindi: उस पशुपत्षीद्दीन एवं मनुष्यब मित बन में, बह राजा तप करने क्यों आया था ? यह ठीक ठीक जानने की मेरी इच्छा है

verses.sloka: गर्गश्च च्यवनश्चैव शतानन्दश्च धर्मवित् ।भरद्वाजश्च तेजस्वी ह्यग्निपुत्रश्च सुप्रभः ।। ७.९६.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: gargaśca cyavanaścaiva śatānandaśca dharmavit ।bharadvājaśca tejasvī hyagniputraśca suprabhaḥ ।। 7.96.4 ॥

translations.english: Garga, Chyavana, Shatananda the knower of dharma, the radiant Bharadvaja, and the brilliant Agniputra were also among them.

verses.sloka: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव गौतमश्च महायशाः ।कात्यायनः सुयज्ञश्च ह्यगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः ।। ७.९६.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva gautamaśca mahāyaśāḥ ।kātyāyanaḥ suyajñaśca hyagastyastapasāṁ nidhiḥ ।। 7.96.5 ॥

translations.english: Narada, Parvata, the highly renowned Gautama, Katyayana, Suyajna, and Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, were also present.

verses.sloka: एते चान्ये च बहवो मुनयः संशितव्रताः ।कौतूहलसमाविष्टाः सर्व एव समागताः ।। ७.९६.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo munayaḥ saṁśitavratāḥ ।kautūhalasamāviṣṭāḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ ।। 7.96.6 ॥

translations.english: These and many other sages of firm vows, all filled with curiosity, had assembled.
translations.hindi: महाराज मनु ने अपने दुर्जेय पुत्र महाराज इच्त्राकु को राज- सिंहासन पर बिठा कर, उनसे कहा--तुम राजा होकर, इस प्रथिवी पर राजबंशों की प्रतिष्ठा करो

verses.sloka: राक्षसाश्च महावीर्या वानराश्च महाबलाः ।सर्व एव समाजग्मुर्महात्मानः कुतूहलात् ।। ७.९६.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasāśca mahāvīryā vānarāśca mahābalāḥ ।sarva eva samājagmurmahātmānaḥ kutūhalāt ।। 7.96.7 ॥

translations.english: All the great-souled demons of immense valor and monkeys of great strength assembled there out of curiosity.

verses.sloka: क्षत्रिया ये च शूद्राश्च वैश्याश्चैव सहस्रशः ।नानादेशगताश्चैव ब्राह्मणाः संशितव्रताः ।। ७.९६.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyā ye ca śūdrāśca vaiśyāścaiva sahasraśaḥ ।nānādeśagatāścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ saṁśitavratāḥ ।। 7.96.8 ॥

translations.english: Thousands of Kshatriyas, Shudras, and Vaishyas, along with Brahmins of firm vows from various countries, also gathered.
translations.hindi: हे परमोदार पुत्र ! मैं तुम्हारे ऊपर प्रसन्न हूँ । तुम वंशकत्ता होगे । तुर दण्ड द्वारा प्रजा की रक्षा करना, परन्तु किसी निरपराध को दण्ड मत देना

verses.sloka: ज्ञाननिष्ठाः कर्मनिष्ठाः योगनिष्ठास्तथापरे ।सीताशपथवीक्षार्थं सर्व एव समागताः ।। ७.९६.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: jñānaniṣṭhāḥ karmaniṣṭhāḥ yoganiṣṭhāstathāpare ।sītāśapathavīkṣārthaṁ sarva eva samāgatāḥ ।। 7.96.9 ॥

translations.english: All these, including those devoted to knowledge, action, and yoga, had assembled there to witness Sita's oath.

verses.sloka: तदा समागतं सर्वमश्मभूतमिवाचलम् ।श्रुत्वा मुनिवरस्तूर्णं ससीतः समुपागमत् ।। ७.९६.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tadā samāgataṁ sarvamaśmabhūtamivācalam ।śrutvā munivarastūrṇaṁ sasītaḥ samupāgamat ।। 7.96.10 ॥

translations.english: Then, hearing that everyone had assembled and stood unmoving like a stone, the best of sages, Valmiki, quickly approached with Sita.
translations.hindi: अतएव हे महाबाहो ! हे बेटा ! दरड देने में तुम बहुत सावधान रहना । शासन करते समय यथोचित रीत्या बढ़े पुण्य की प्राप्ति होगी

verses.sloka: तमृषिं पृष्ठतः सीता त्वन्वगच्छदवाङ्मुखी ।कृताञ्जलिर्बाष्पगला कृत्वा रामं मनोगतम् ।। ७.९६.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamṛṣiṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītā tvanvagacchadavāṅmukhī ।kṛtāñjalirbāṣpagalā kṛtvā rāmaṁ manogatam ।। 7.96.11 ॥

translations.english: Sita, with a downcast face, folded hands, and a voice choked with tears, followed that sage from behind, having fixed Rama in her mind.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा श्रुतिमिवायान्तीं ब्रह्माणमनुगामिनीम् ।वाल्मीकेः पृष्ठतः सीतां साधुवादो महानभूत् ।। ७.९६.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śrutimivāyāntīṁ brahmāṇamanugāminīm ।vālmīkeḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sītāṁ sādhuvādo mahānabhūt ।। 7.96.12 ॥

translations.english: Upon seeing Sita following Valmiki, appearing like a Veda following Brahma, a great acclamation of "excellent" arose from the crowd.
translations.hindi: उनके स्वर्गवासी होने पर, महापराक्रमी इदवाकु को यह चिता हुई कि, में कैसे उत्पन्न करूँ

verses.sloka: ततो हलहलाशब्दः सर्वेषामेवमाबभौ ।दुःखजन्मविशालेन शोकेनाकुलितात्मनाम् ।। ७.९६.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato halahalāśabdaḥ sarveṣāmevamābabhau ।duḥkhajanmaviśālena śokenākulitātmanām ।। 7.96.13 ॥

translations.english: Then, a tumultuous clamor arose from all those whose minds were agitated by the vast sorrow born of their distress.

verses.sloka: साधु रामेति केचित्तु साधु सीतेति चापरे ।उभावेव च तत्रान्ये प्रेक्षकाः सम्प्रचुक्रुशुः ।। ७.९६.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sādhu rāmeti kecittu sādhu sīteti cāpare ।ubhāveva ca tatrānye prekṣakāḥ sampracukruśuḥ ।। 7.96.14 ॥

translations.english: Some spectators acclaimed, "Excellent, Rama!", others cried, "Excellent, Sita!", and still others there loudly praised both of them.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! उनमें जो सब से छोटा था, वह बड़ा मूखे और बिद्याद्दीन था। वह अपने बड़ों की सेबा शुश्रूपा नहीं करता था

verses.sloka: ततो मध्ये जनौघस्य प्रविश्य मुनिपुङ्गवः ।सीतासहायो वाल्मीकिरिति होवाच राघवम् ।। ७.९६.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato madhye janaughasya praviśya munipuṅgavaḥ ।sītāsahāyo vālmīkiriti hovāca rāghavam ।। 7.96.15 ॥

translations.english: Then, having entered the midst of the multitude of people, Valmiki, the foremost of sages, accompanied by Sita, spoke thus to Rama.
translations.hindi: उस अल्पतेजस्वी पुत्र का नाम महाराज इद्बाकु ने दण्ड रखा । यह नाम इस लिए रखा कि, उन्दने समझ लिआ कि, इस मूखे पर दृण्डपात ( इसकी मूखताबश ) अवश्य होगा

verses.sloka: इयं दाशरथे सीता सुव्रता धर्मचारिणी ।अपवादैः परित्यक्ता ममाश्रमसमीपतः ।। ७.९६.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: iyaṁ dāśarathe sītā suvratā dharmacāriṇī ।apavādaiḥ parityaktā mamāśramasamīpataḥ ।। 7.96.16 ॥

translations.english: O son of Dasharatha, this is Sita, virtuous and righteous, who was abandoned near my hermitage due to public slanders.
translations.hindi: उत्तरक गरा हे शत्रुसूदन ! हे राम ! जैसा दण्ड उद्दण्ड पुत्र था, वैसा ही इसके योग्य इच्वाकु ने बिन्ध्याचल और शेवल पवत के बीच के देश का अति घोर राज्य इसको दिरा

verses.sloka: लोकापवादभीतस्य तव राम महाव्रत ।प्रत्ययं दास्यते सीता तदनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। ७.९६.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: lokāpavādabhītasya tava rāma mahāvrata ।pratyayaṁ dāsyate sītā tadanujñātumarhasi ।। 7.96.17 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, keeper of great vows, you who are fearful of public scandal, Sita will provide proof, and you ought to permit her to do so.
translations.hindi: ह उन इनु पवर्तो के बीच वाले देश का दण्ड राजा हुआ । है राम : वहां उसने एक बहुत उत्तम नगर भी बसाया

verses.sloka: इमौ तु जानकीपुत्रावुभौ च यमजातकौ ।सुतौ तवैव दुर्धर्षौ सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि ते ।। ७.९६.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: imau tu jānakīputrāvubhau ca yamajātakau ।sutau tavaiva durdharṣau satyametadbravīmi te ।। 7.96.18 ॥

translations.english: These two formidable sons, born as twins to Janaki, are indeed your own sons, and I speak this truth to you.

verses.sloka: प्रचेतसो ऽहं दशमः पुत्रो राघवनन्दन ।न स्मराम्यनृतं वाक्यमिमौ तु तव पुत्रकौ ।। ७.९६.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: pracetaso 'haṁ daśamaḥ putro rāghavanandana ।na smarāmyanṛtaṁ vākyamimau tu tava putrakau ।। 7.96.19 ॥

translations.english: O delight of the Raghus, I am the tenth son of Prachetas, and I have never uttered a lie; these two are indeed your sons.

verses.sloka: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तपश्चर्या मया कृता ।नोपाश्नीयां फलं तस्या दुष्टेयं यदि मैथिली ।। ७.९६.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścaryā mayā kṛtā ।nopāśnīyāṁ phalaṁ tasyā duṣṭeyaṁ yadi maithilī ।। 7.96.20 ॥

translations.english: If this Maithili were impure, I would not partake of the fruit of the penance that I have performed for many thousands of years.

verses.sloka: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भूतपूर्वं न किल्बिषम् ।तस्याः फलमुपाश्नीयामपापा मैथिली यदि ।। ७.९६.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: manasā karmaṇā vācā bhūtapūrvaṁ na kilbiṣam ।tasyāḥ phalamupāśnīyāmapāpā maithilī yadi ।। 7.96.21 ॥

translations.english: If Maithili is sinless, then may I enjoy the fruit of never having committed any sin by thought, word, or deed.

verses.sloka: अहं पञ्चसु भूतेषु मनष्षष्ठेषु राघव ।विचिन्त्य सीतां शुद्धेति जग्राह वननिर्झरे ।। ७.९६.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ pañcasu bhūteṣu manaṣṣaṣṭheṣu rāghava ।vicintya sītāṁ śuddheti jagrāha vananirjhare ।। 7.96.22 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, I, who am present in the five elements and the mind as the sixth, accepted Sita as pure, having considered her in the forest stream.

verses.sloka: इयं शुद्धसमाचारा अपापा पतिदेवता ।लोकापवादभीतस्य प्रत्ययं तव दास्यति ।। ७.९६.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: iyaṁ śuddhasamācārā apāpā patidevatā ।lokāpavādabhītasya pratyayaṁ tava dāsyati ।। 7.96.23 ॥

translations.english: This Sita, who is of pure conduct, sinless, and devoted to her husband as a deity, will provide conviction to you, who feared public scandal.

verses.sloka: तस्मादियं नरवरात्मज शुद्धभावा दिव्येन दृष्टिविषयेण तदा प्रविष्टा ।लोकापवादकलुषीकृतचेतसा या त्यक्ता त्वया प्रियतमा विदिता ऽपि शुद्धा ।। ७.९६.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmādiyaṁ naravarātmaja śuddhabhāvā divyena dṛṣṭiviṣayeṇa tadā praviṣṭā ।lokāpavādakaluṣīkṛtacetasā yā tyaktā tvayā priyatamā viditā 'pi śuddhā ।। 7.96.24 ।।

translations.english: Therefore, O son of the best among men, this Sita of pure nature, whom you, whose mind was defiled by public scandal, abandoned even though she was known to be pure and dearest to you, then entered the divine realm. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः ।। 96 ।। Thus ends the ninety-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
